name: app-factory-delivery-security-controls
description: Security, privacy and supply-chain controls evaluated by 'stage security'. Evidence is supplied by the reviewer through a JSON evidence file; unevidenced controls are reported as 'unknown', never as passing.

controls.control: No credentials, API keys or tokens are committed in source, fixtures or configuration examples.
controls.evidence_hint: Secret scan output or a manual grep of the release set; reference secret-manager names instead of values.

controls.control: Runtime secrets are injected by the environment or a secret manager and are never logged.
controls.evidence_hint: Configuration loader path plus a log sample proving redaction.

controls.control: Authentication uses a vetted mechanism with safe session or token lifetimes and revocation.
controls.evidence_hint: Auth flow description, token lifetime values, logout/revocation behaviour.

controls.control: Every server-side operation enforces authorization for the acting principal, not just the UI.
controls.evidence_hint: Table of endpoints/actions mapped to required roles, plus one denial test.

controls.control: All external input is validated and normalized at the trust boundary with explicit size and type limits.
controls.evidence_hint: Schema or validator location, limits applied, rejection behaviour.

controls.control: Queries, commands and templates use parameterization or allowlists; no string-built SQL, shell or HTML from input.
controls.evidence_hint: Representative query/builder code and the parameterization point.

controls.control: Output encoding and a content security policy prevent script injection in rendered surfaces.
controls.evidence_hint: CSP header or meta tag and the escaping strategy for dynamic fragments.

controls.control: All network traffic uses TLS with certificate validation enabled; no insecure fallbacks remain.
controls.evidence_hint: Client configuration, validation flags, HSTS or pinning decision.

controls.control: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest and classified; keys have an owner and rotation path.
controls.evidence_hint: Data classification table and encryption/key management source.

controls.control: Personal data collection is minimized, disclosed, retention-limited and deletable on request.
controls.evidence_hint: Field inventory with purpose, retention period, export/delete path.

controls.control: Telemetry and analytics are consent-gated where required and exclude sensitive payloads.
controls.evidence_hint: Consent gate location and the list of emitted event fields.

controls.control: Dependencies are pinned, reviewed and free of known critical advisories at release time.
controls.evidence_hint: Lockfile name and audit command output studied during release.

controls.control: Build inputs and release artifacts have provenance: checksums, SBOM and trusted sources only.
controls.evidence_hint: manifest/checksum generation path and SBOM location.

controls.control: Errors return safe messages to clients while detailed diagnostics stay in server-side logs.
controls.evidence_hint: Error handler location and a sample client-facing error payload.

controls.control: Security-relevant events (auth success/failure, privilege change, data export) are logged with correlation ids.
controls.evidence_hint: Event catalogue and one captured structured log line.

controls.control: Abusive or accidental traffic is bounded by rate limits, quotas and payload size caps.
controls.evidence_hint: Limit values per endpoint class and the enforcement point.

controls.control: Uploads are type-checked, size-limited, stored outside the web root and scanned or rejected when unverifiable.
controls.evidence_hint: Validation chain, storage location, and rejection path.

controls.control: Secure defaults ship in configuration and unsafe options require explicit opt-in with a warning.
controls.evidence_hint: Default configuration file and the documented unsafe overrides.

controls.control: Sessions and tokens expire, rotate on privilege change and are invalidated on logout or credential reset.
controls.evidence_hint: Lifetime values and invalidation code path.

controls.control: Only current, vetted cryptographic primitives are used; no custom crypto or deprecated hashes for passwords.
controls.evidence_hint: Library and algorithm choices with parameters (cost, key size).

controls.control: Pipeline permissions, secrets and artifacts are least-privilege and pin third-party actions to reviewed versions.
controls.evidence_hint: Workflow permission block and action pinning policy.

controls.control: A restore or rollback path is documented and was exercised for the data and release artifacts.
controls.evidence_hint: Restore drill record or rollback procedure with owner.

controls.control: Third-party licenses are compatible with the delivery model and notices are shipped.
controls.evidence_hint: License inventory from the SBOM and the notice file path.

controls.control: Platform and store policies are satisfied (permissions, privacy declarations, data safety labels).
controls.evidence_hint: Permission list with justification and the draft declaration text.

controls.control: Failure of any single dependency degrades safely with bounded retries and timeouts.
controls.evidence_hint: Timeout/retry values per integration and the degradation behaviour.

controls.control: Accessibility and abuse-resistance requirements are covered by tests, not only by guidelines.
controls.evidence_hint: Failing-test-or-passing-test evidence for keyboard and announcement paths.
